problem: Every pair of a nondegenerate triangle's interior angles sums to less than two right angles.

proof_idea.original: Extend a side and compare the exterior angle with an opposite interior angle using I.16; subtract from the straight-angle sum.
proof_idea.analytic: Consume independently derived positive sums of two interior normalized cosines and principal arccos order/supplementary identities; cover all three pairs.

litex_code:
# Book I.17: each pair of interior triangle angles sums to less than two right angles.
thm proposition_17:
    ? forall a, b, c cart(R, R):
        a != b
        a != c
        b != c
        $geometry::main::is_triangle(a, b, c)
        =>:
            ray_angle(b, a, c) + ray_angle(a, b, c) < pi
            ray_angle(b, a, c) + ray_angle(a, c, b) < pi
            ray_angle(a, b, c) + ray_angle(a, c, b) < pi
    by def $geometry::main::is_triangle(a, b, c)
    geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(a, b), geometry::main::vec(a, c))^2 > 0
    release thm geometry::main::triangle_det_squared_vertex(a, b, c)
    geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(b, a), geometry::main::vec(b, c))^2 = geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(a, b), geometry::main::vec(a, c))^2 > 0
    by contra:
        ? geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(b, a), geometry::main::vec(b, c)) != 0
        geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(b, a), geometry::main::vec(b, c)) = 0
        geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(b, a), geometry::main::vec(b, c))^2 = 0
        impossible geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(b, a), geometry::main::vec(b, c))^2 > 0
    by def $geometry::main::is_triangle(b, a, c)
    release thm geometry::main::det_antisymmetric(geometry::main::vec(a, c), geometry::main::vec(a, b))
    by contra:
        ? geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(a, c), geometry::main::vec(a, b)) != 0
        geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(a, c), geometry::main::vec(a, b)) = 0
        -geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(a, b), geometry::main::vec(a, c)) = 0
        geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(a, b), geometry::main::vec(a, c)) = -(-geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(a, b), geometry::main::vec(a, c))) = -0 = 0
        impossible geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(a, b), geometry::main::vec(a, c)) != 0
    by def $geometry::main::is_triangle(a, c, b)
    release thm two_internal_triangle_cosines_sum_positive(a, b, c)
    release thm two_internal_triangle_cosines_sum_positive(b, a, c)
    release thm two_internal_triangle_cosines_sum_positive(a, c, b)
    release thm angle_cosine_arms_symmetric(a, c, b)
    release thm angle_cosine_arms_symmetric(b, a, c)
    angles::angle_cosine(a, b, c) + angles::angle_cosine(a, c, b) = angles::angle_cosine(a, b, c) + angles::angle_cosine(b, c, a) > 0
    angles::angle_cosine(b, a, c) + angles::angle_cosine(a, b, c) = angles::angle_cosine(c, a, b) + angles::angle_cosine(a, b, c) > 0
    release thm angle_cosine_bounded(b, a, c)
    release thm angle_cosine_bounded(a, b, c)
    release thm angle_cosine_bounded(a, c, b)
    release thm positive_cosine_sum_implies_angle_sum_below_pi(angles::angle_cosine(b, a, c), angles::angle_cosine(a, b, c))
    release thm positive_cosine_sum_implies_angle_sum_below_pi(angles::angle_cosine(b, a, c), angles::angle_cosine(a, c, b))
    release thm positive_cosine_sum_implies_angle_sum_below_pi(angles::angle_cosine(a, b, c), angles::angle_cosine(a, c, b))
    ray_angle(b, a, c) + ray_angle(a, b, c) = arccos(angles::angle_cosine(b, a, c)) + arccos(angles::angle_cosine(a, b, c)) < pi
    ray_angle(b, a, c) + ray_angle(a, c, b) = arccos(angles::angle_cosine(b, a, c)) + arccos(angles::angle_cosine(a, c, b)) < pi
    ray_angle(a, b, c) + ray_angle(a, c, b) = arccos(angles::angle_cosine(a, b, c)) + arccos(angles::angle_cosine(a, c, b)) < pi
